name: JMPGraphics Shop Builder
author: jmpereiragraphics

sections.description:
JMPGraphics Shop Builder is a powerful tool designed to give you total control over your WooCommerce store using Elementor. No more theme limitations—design your Single Product, Cart, Checkout, and Archive pages exactly how you want.

Features

The plugin offers an ecosystem of specialized widgets:

Single Product Widgets

  • Product Title: Dynamic product title.
  • Product Price: Display simple and variable prices.
  • Product Image: Main image with zoom support.
  • Product Add to Cart: Standard WooCommerce purchase button.
  • Product Description: Short or full description.
  • Product Meta: SKU, Categories, and Tags.
  • Product Gallery: Gallery grid or slider.
  • Product Tabs: Description, Additional Information, and Reviews.
  • Product Related: List of related products.
  • Product Dynamic Splash: Ink sequence splash and animated product presentation.

Archive & Shop Widgets

  • Product Archive Grid: The main product listing.
  • Smart Grid (Full Editor) (Pro): Advanced product grid with countdown timers, sale badges, legal dates, and source filtering.
  • Product Categories: List of categories for navigation.
  • Product Attribute Filter: Advanced filters by color, size, or brand.
  • Product Banner (Pro): Dynamic marketing banners with smart queries.
  • Responsive Slider (Pro): Dynamic product carousel with responsive image layers.

Cart & Checkout Widgets

  • Cart Table: List of products in the cart with coupon fields, update buttons, and customizable native cross-sells styling.
  • Cart Totals: Summary of values, taxes, and shipping.
  • Cart Cross-Sell Badge (Pro): Compact cross-sell offer badge with AJAX quick add.
  • Mini Cart (Pro): Floating/interactive cart.
  • Checkout Billing (Pro): Billing details form.
  • Order Review V2 (Pro): Detailed summary with modern item layout and badges.
  • Order Bump (Pro): One-click upsell offer inside the checkout.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Templates Builder > Settings to manage widgets and assign your templates.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin work with the free version of Elementor?

Yes, it is designed to work with both Elementor Free and Pro.

Can I create different templates for different categories?

Currently, the plugin supports global template assignment for Single Products and Archives.
sections.changelog:
1.2.7

  • New Feature: Added product launch and pre-order settings to the WooCommerce product editor, including launch date/time, purchase blocking or pre-order mode, and a configurable pre-order button label.
  • New Widget: Added the Product Launch Countdown widget with configurable title, expired message, counter colors, typography, background, border, radius, spacing, and alignment.
  • Product Stock: Added restock notification subscriptions, email lead management, manual notification sending, and scheduled restock date controls in the Shop Builder admin area.
  • Product Stock: Added styling controls for stock messages, notification buttons, email fields, and scheduled restock dates.
  • Cart Table: Added native cross-sell product count, column count, card width, and grid layout controls; corrected display of multiple cross-sell products.
  • Cart Table: Added a dedicated pre-order details row below each product, with controls for text color, typography, background, border, radius, padding, spacing, alignment, and inline or stacked presentation.
  • Cart Table: Added independent typography and color controls for the subtotal and improved cart item layout for pre-order metadata.
  • Cart Cross-Sell Badge (Pro): Added support for multiple cross-sell offers, manual product selection by ID, and automatic product cross-sell assignment.
  • Cart Cross-Sell Badge (Pro): Added card image sizing, card height, border, radius, and button positioning controls, and improved prefix, title, and price typography.
  • Mini Cart (Pro): Fixed duplicate product thumbnails and improved item layout so pre-order metadata does not squeeze product titles, quantities, or prices.
  • Product Tabs: Added an option to show or hide reviews and fixed duplicate star ratings.
  • Product Add to Cart: Added styling controls for quantity fields, including text and background colors, border, radius, and padding.

1.2.6

  • Product Categories: Fixed numeric pagination and Load More behavior, and expanded product query and category selection options, including manual selection and hierarchical display.
  • Product Categories: Added optional inline carousel controls, responsive category navigation arrows with normal and hover styling, and corrected full-width carousel and indented vertical subcategory layouts.
  • Product Categories: Added product card shadows, image fitting options, sale badge text and taxonomy settings, border radius controls, title character limits, and price alignment across product cards.
  • Product Attribute Filter: Added responsive sidebar width controls, hierarchical subcategory display options, parent category icon selection and styling, and improved category hierarchy handling and alignment.
  • Product Attribute Filter: Added checkbox-based attribute filtering and a configurable Clear Filters button, while refining category rows, counts, and sidebar styles.
  • Mini Cart (Pro): Added sidebar product title visibility and character limit controls, improved title and quantity/price space allocation, and added remove-item icon color, hover color, and size controls.
  • Mini Cart (Pro): Ensured the widget loads its PRO stylesheet in Elementor previews and clarified use of WooCommerce’s native product thumbnail.
  • Maintenance: Removed development console logging from public scripts and suppressed the jQuery Migrate installation notice without disabling its compatibility behavior.

1.2.5

  • Improvement: Added responsive mobile navigation dropdown layout controls, full-width panel support, and unified styling for menu items and nested submenus.
  • Improvement: Added promotion tooltip positioning above or beside menu items, with a lateral spacing control and submenu width that accommodates side-positioned tooltips.
  • Improvement: Added adjustable Mini Cart sidebar width and a full-width dropdown option for tablet and mobile screens.
  • Improvement: Added a responsive top offset control for the Mini Cart card and kept the full-width dropdown aligned to the cart trigger without clipping at the viewport edges.

1.2.4

  • Fix: Corrected the Freemius account menu registration so the account and license pages open under the Shop Builder menu.
  • Fix: Repaired Order Bump cart requests and enabled the widget to add or remove its configured product from any Elementor page or template.
  • Improvement: Added responsive styling controls for slider navigation arrows, including visibility, color, background, size, and vertical position.
  • Improvement: Added responsive product carousel item height controls and independent old-price styling for color, typography, and vertical spacing.
  • Fix: Improved tablet and mobile navigation dropdown toggling and nested submenu alignment.
  • Maintenance: Updated the Freemius WordPress SDK to 2.13.5.

1.2.3

  • New Feature: Added individual product card styling, gap spacing controls, and list-bullet removal for Native Cross-Sells in the Cart Table widget.
  • Style Improvement: Refactored Cart Cross-Sell Badge (Pro) CSS layout for strict side-by-side horizontal alignment.
  • Bug Fix: Fixed PHP syntax error in Cart Cross-Sell Pro widget logic.

1.2.2

  • New Feature: Added full layout customization for Native Cross-Sells in the Cart Table widget (individual product cards, gap spacing, typography, and card background styling).
  • New Feature: Added responsive width control to the “Product Dynamic Splash” widget.
  • Improvement: Re-architected Cart Cross-Sell Badge (Pro) CSS layout for seamless horizontal alignment inside WooCommerce tables.
  • Security: Hardened security by escaping output and sanitizing input across admin settings and product variation widgets.
  • Maintenance: Refactored code to comply with WordPress coding standards, resolving PHPCS warnings.

1.2.0

  • Added Smart Grid (Full Editor) widget with real-time countdown timers and legal date ranges.
  • Added product source type selector (Sale products vs. Recent/General products) for flexible grid queries.
  • Fixed CSS specificity issues preventing active and sale price color changes from the Elementor editor.
  • Improved frontend and backend visibility handling with helpful editor notices when queries return empty results.

1.1.0

  • Added Order Bump Widget for checkout upsells.
  • Added Product Banner Widget with dynamic source selection.
  • Overhauled Order Review widget to V2 with modern badge layout.
  • Fixed template loading issue by standardizing option keys.
  • Improved AJAX synchronization between Checkout and Cart.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • Inclusion of initial widgets for Elementor.
  • Admin panel with contemporary design.
  • Dynamic template interception system.
